title: The essential clathrin adapter protein complex-2 is tumor suppressive specifically in vivo
model: Five pancreatic cancer lines (BXPC-3, CFPAC-1, HPAF-II, MIAPACA-2, PANC-1), 660-sgRNA PtdIns-metabolism KO library
contrast: Xenograft tumors vs cultures after two weeks, per line (8 vs 4)
paper_method: Mean guide fold change, control z-score, t-test in vivo vs in vitro
paper_calls: 14-39 genes per line at FDR 0.10; AP2 subunits and PTEN enriched in vivo
barcs_calls: 0-14 genes per line at FDR 0.10 (median-ratio totals); HPAF-II: AP2S1, AP2M1, AP2A1, PTEN
named_hits: AP2M1, AP2S1, AP2A1, PTEN pass FDR 0.10 in HPAF-II only; top-ranked but FDR 0.11-0.23 in BXPC-3 and PANC-1
verdict: BARCS ranks AP2 subunits and PTEN as the top in vivo-enriched genes in BXPC-3, PANC-1 and HPAF-II and confirms AP2 essentiality in culture, but the large tumor-to-tumor variance leaves them significant only in HPAF-II.
